result.reason: The operative text does not reach even the fallback. Although it adds a Licensor IP indemnity, Article XIII still expressly disclaims Licensor liability for infringement claims and caps all liability at one-half of fees, rather than providing the required 3× annual-fees super-cap. The clause also lacks customary IP exclusions, a complete remedies structure, and indemnity procedures. Licensee’s indemnity remains internally contradictory and overbroad because the original triggers for exercising license rights, conducting its business, and any contractual breach were not deleted; it is not limited to Licensee-provided content and breach of law. The margin comment cannot cure these operative defects. Drafting is further impaired by conflicting causation language, an incomplete remedy set, and the surviving 'breach by the License' error.
